annotations.title: Sync lead-form leads to a Mailchimp audience

description: Put the leads the brand's LEAD FORMS collected (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, X Ads, Snapchat, ChatGPT Ads) into a Mailchimp AUDIENCE: each lead with an email is added with their name. By default they are NOT subscribed (a non-marketing 'transactional' contact), because a lead form is not consent Hermoso can vouch for; pass consented:true only when the user confirms the form asked for marketing consent. An existing contact's status is never changed, and synced leads are remembered per audience so a re-run never repeats a write. since (default 7 days ago), platforms narrows it, dryRun:true lists what would be synced. Free. Needs Mailchimp connected (Connectors > Mailchimp, or connect_connector with an API key).
name: sync_leads_to_mailchimp
title: Sync lead-form leads to a Mailchimp audience
